editor.title: Edit survey
editor.warning: This survey has {{count}} response(s). Edits to questions will be recorded with a warning to preserve analytics consistency.
editor.questionsHint: Drag to reorder within a category. Each question is answered on a 1–5 scale (1 worst, 5 best).
editor.emptyGroup: No questions in this category yet.
editor.categoriesHint: Organize questions into groups. Categories will be used to break down analytics later.
editor.noCategories: No categories yet — questions will appear under "Uncategorized".
editor.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete this category? Its questions will move to "Uncategorized".
editor.editQuestionConfirm: This survey already has responses. Editing question text may affect how analytics map historical answers. Proceed?
editor.deleteQuestionConfirm: Delete this question? Existing answers to it will be removed.

errors.crossCategoryDrag: Use the category dropdown to move a question between categories.

emptyReasons.no_responses: No responses have been submitted for this survey yet.
emptyReasons.filtered_out: Your filters excluded every response. Remove or relax the gender / occupation / age filters.
emptyReasons.empty_groups: The combination of X-axis and group-by produced no matching rows. Try a different dimension.

analytics.resetConfirm: Reset this chart to its default configuration?

builder.defaultHint: Editing built-in chart — your changes apply to this survey only. Use Reset on the analytics card to revert.
builder.generalHint: This chart is general — it will appear on every survey's analytics page (rendered against that survey's data) and can be exported against any selection.

export.title: Export to Excel
export.subtitle: Select surveys, content sheets, default charts, and any saved custom charts. Charts are embedded as native Excel charts (editable in Excel) backed by real data tables.
export.includeAgg: Aggregated analytics (per-question averages, response counts by demographic, and a per-question-by-demographic breakdown)
export.defaultsHint: Each selected default is exported once per selected survey. If you've edited a default for a particular survey, the override is used automatically.
export.customHint: Each selected chart is written as a native Excel chart (Bar / Line / Pie / Radar) sitting next to its data table, so you can edit it inside Excel.
export.customEmpty: No custom charts yet. Build one on a survey's Analytics page.
